data.name: student-api
data.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: student-api
  namespace: campus-dev
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: student-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: student-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: student-api
        image: ghcr.io/campus/student-api:1.8.4
        env:
        - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          value: dev
